description: Inventory from T-003, build-time group: DockerRuntimeDockerfileBuilder, SnapshotBakeScript, BootHeadStartScript. Different semantics from both other groups - there is no dply preamble, failure means a bad image rather than a broken host, and a Dockerfile RUN should usually fail loudly. Decide per script whether tolerance is right at all; BootHeadStartScript already guards its update inside an if. Possibly a no-op ticket that records the decision.
title: Decide the apt-update policy for image-bake and cloud-init scripts
